objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other organizational content subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archiving workflows.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type describing locally defined or business-process-specific regulations and instructions.

objs.name: procedureinstruction
objs.description: A document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: workinstruction
objs.description: A document type documenting detailed work steps and sub-processes such as test instructions with compliance criteria.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: A document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document, used for supplementary information such as brief instructions or photos.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with its main document, subject to the main document's release process and versioning.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A document capturing proposed amendments to an existing document without affecting its content or version history.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user role responsible for creating and editing document content, signing the creation step of the release workflow.

objs.name: coauthor
objs.description: A user with personal change rights on a document, having no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user role responsible for the document and its content, deciding whether to release and distribute the document to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user role responsible for translating released content into another language.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user role with permission to view approved documents and dependent objects.

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: A system-generated request to review and confirm ongoing validity of a document before its expiration date.

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity or must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A maintained list of user groups and persons assigned to receive document distributions by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: documentversion
objs.description: A specific release state of a document, created when the document is released or revised.

objs.name: template
objs.description: A predefined structure for a document type, used to standardize document creation and metadata.

objs.name: usergroup
objs.description: A grouping of users assigned authorization rights or distribution responsibilities for documents.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic signature applied by a workflow participant during document release, documented in the system for traceability.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A documented confirmation by a reader that they have received and reviewed a distributed document.

objs.name: archiveddocument
objs.description: A document that has been invalidated or archived, with revoked user authorizations except for the archive user group.

objs.name: archivegroup
objs.description: A user group retaining read access to archived documents while other authorizations are revoked.

objs.name: languageversion
objs.description: A translated version of a released document in a language other than the original.

objs.name: editingstatus
objs.description: The draft state of a document before it is released, allowing content and property modifications.

objs.name: releasedstatus
objs.description: The state of a document after successful completion of the approval workflow, making it visible to authorized readers.

objs.name: outofforcestatus
objs.description: The state of a document that has been invalidated and removed from circulation.

objs.name: documenttype
objs.description: A classification category for documents such as Policy, Guideline, ProcedureInstruction, or WorkInstruction.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific descriptive properties maintained for a document via categories and attributes.

objs.name: dualcontrolprinciple
objs.description: A governance rule preventing the same person from serving as both author and reviewer on a document.

evts.name: createdocument
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object with selection of document type and optional template to initiate document creation.

evts.name: editdocumentcontent
evts.description: Modification of document content using an editing client, with automatic conversion to PDF upon saving.

evts.name: maintaindocumentproperties
evts.description: Creation or modification of document metadata and attributes through categorized property dialogs.

evts.name: maintainauthorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related read and change authorizations to a document.

evts.name: createchangeproposal
evts.description: Submission of a proposed amendment to an existing document by any employee with author rights.

evts.name: implementchangeproposal
evts.description: Approval and integration of a change proposal into a new version of the document.

evts.name: initiatereleaseworkflow
evts.description: Start of the 3-step approval process consisting of Creator signature, Review, and Release steps.

evts.name: signdocument
evts.description: Electronic signature applied by the creator, reviewer, or releaser during the approval workflow.

evts.name: approvedocument
evts.description: Positive completion of the review step by all assigned reviewers to proceed to release.

evts.name: releasedocument
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by at least one assigned releaser, making it visible to readers.

evts.name: rejectdocument
evts.description: Negative decision during review or release that cancels the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publishdocument
evts.description: Automatic distribution of a released document to assigned readers and user groups.

evts.name: distributedocumentbyemail
evts.description: Sending email notification of a new document version to assigned users and user groups.

evts.name: requestacknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic workflow task requesting readers to confirm receipt and review of a distributed document.

evts.name: confirmacknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by a reader that they have received and reviewed a document.

evts.name: revisedocument
evts.description: Creation of a new editing version of a released document while retaining previous version data.

evts.name: archiveattachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment as archived, with actual archiving occurring upon release of the next document version.

evts.name: translatedocument
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language by a translator role.

evts.name: approvetranslation
evts.description: Review and release workflow for a translated document version by designated reviewers and releasers.

evts.name: extendvalidity
evts.description: Confirmation and extension of document validity for a subsequent period when validity review is approved.

evts.name: createvalidityextensionrequest
evts.description: System-generated request initiated 30 days before a document's validity expiration date.

evts.name: processvalidityextensionrequest
evts.description: Workflow-supported evaluation and approval of a validity extension request by designated participants.

evts.name: invalidatedocument
evts.description: Declaration of a document as out-of-force and archiving, revoking user authorizations except for archive group.

evts.name: createoverriderequest
evts.description: User submission of a request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has validity.

evts.name: processoverriderequest
evts.description: Workflow-supported evaluation and approval of an override request by initiator, reviewers, and releasers.

evts.name: reactivatedocument
evts.description: Restoration of a previously invalidated document to valid status with original metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: createreactivationrequest
evts.description: Business admin initiation of a request to reactivate a previously archived document.

evts.name: processreactivationrequest
evts.description: Workflow confirmation of a reactivation request, creating a new version with restored properties and authorizations.

evts.name: maintaindistributionlist
evts.description: Assignment of user groups and persons to receive document distributions by email or for acknowledgement.

evts.name: viewdocument
evts.description: Access and display of an approved document and its dependent objects by an authorized reader.

evts.name: searchdocuments
evts.description: Query and retrieval of documents based on role-specific evaluation criteria and parameters.

evts.name: generatereport
evts.description: Production of a role-specific evaluation report on document status, workflows, or acknowledgements.

evts.name: managetag
evts.description: Automatic insertion of document metadata such as version, status, and scope into document content via TAG technology.

evts.name: convertpdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of a saved document to PDF format for display on the web.

evts.name: assignreaderauthorization
evts.description: Granting of read-only access to a document via assignment of users to reader user groups.

evts.name: assignauthorrole
evts.description: Designation of a primary author responsible for document creation and first workflow step signature.

evts.name: assignreviewerrole
evts.description: Designation of reviewers responsible for technical and formal content evaluation.

evts.name: assignreleaserrole
evts.description: Designation of a releaser responsible for final document approval and distribution decision.

evts.name: assigntranslatorrole
evts.description: Designation of a translator responsible for translating released content into another language.

o2o.description: A document has multiple versions created through release and revision cycles.
Each released document version contains signatures from workflow participants for traceability.
A document can have attachments that are controlled and released with the main document.
A document can have additional information that is not subject to the main document release cycle.
Change proposals are associated with a specific document and tracked separately from its version history.
Documents can reference or link to other documents via maintained reference attributes.
A document is created from or based on a template of its document type.
A document has an associated distribution list defining which users receive it by email or acknowledgement.
A validity extension request is linked to a specific document for validity review.
An override request targets a specific document for invalidation and archiving.
A released document can have translated language versions released through their own approval workflow.
An archived document is associated with the archive group that retains read access.
One or more templates are defined for each document type.
Co-authors are assigned as additional users with change rights alongside the primary author.
Authors and reviewers are different roles maintained under the dual control principle.
Reviewers and releasers are distinct roles participating in different workflow steps.
Users assigned to the Authors user group are offered in author selection lists for documents.
Readers are grouped into reader user groups that determine document visibility in dashboards.
Users assigned to the Reviewer user group are offered in reviewer selection lists for documents.
Users assigned to the Releaser user group are offered in releaser selection lists for documents.
Distribution lists contain references to user groups for email notification and acknowledgement.
Distribution lists assign individual readers direct authorization to access documents.
Metadata attributes are maintained as categorized properties of each document.
Attachments are versioned alongside their main document and released with it.
Archived documents retain read access for members of the designated archive group.
Documents in editing status are works-in-progress that precede release.
Documents with released status are visible to authorized readers.
Documents with out-of-force status have been invalidated and archived.
Policies and guidelines are different document types serving different regulatory purposes.
Guidelines define roles and framework; procedure instructions describe specific procedures within that framework.
Work instructions provide detailed procedural steps and sub-processes beyond the scope of procedure instructions.
A reactivation request targets a specific archived document for restoration to valid status.
A validity extension request can be terminated if an override request is created instead.

The author initiates document creation by attaching a new information object.
A document's content is edited in editing status using an editing client.
The author edits document content.
A document's metadata and attributes are created or modified through property dialogs.
The author or designated users maintain document properties.
A document receives group and person-level authorization assignments.
The author or administrator assigns authorizations to a document.
A change proposal is created and linked to an existing document.
Any employee with author rights creates a change proposal.

The document author implements an approved change proposal.
A document enters the 3-step release workflow.

Reviewers sign their approval during the review step.
Releasers sign their approval during the release step.
A document receives signatures from workflow participants.
Electronic signatures are created and documented during the workflow.
All assigned reviewers must approve for the document to proceed to release.
A document is approved during the review step.
At least one assigned releaser approves and releases the document.
A document is released and published to readers.
A reviewer can reject the document, canceling the workflow for all subsequent participants.
A releaser can reject the document, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.
A document is rejected during review or release.
A released document is automatically published and visible to authorized readers.
Readers receive automatic access to published documents.
A document version is distributed via email notification to assigned users and groups.
Users in assigned user groups receive email distribution notifications.
Directly assigned readers receive email distribution notifications.
A document requests acknowledgement from assigned readers upon release.
Readers receive a workflow task requesting acknowledgement of a document.
A reader confirms receipt and review of a distributed document.

Reviewers participate in validity extension in the full process.

Reviewers participate in processing in the full process.

Reviewers evaluate the override request in step two.
Releasers approve the override request in step three.
A business admin initiates a reactivation request for an archived document.
A reactivation request targets a specific archived document.

A document's distribution list is maintained to assign reader access.
